name: Gartner
description: Gartner sells subscription research and advice (Insights) to executives in technology, business functions and supply chain, runs paid in-person conferences, and does project consulting. Insights is 78% of revenue and about 77% gross contribution margin; contract value was $5.2 billion at end-2025, up only 1% at constant currency. It sold its Digital Markets software-review lead-generation unit on 2026-02-05 after a $150 million goodwill write-down, and lost much of its U.S. federal government subscription base in 2025. It has bought back about $2.0 billion of stock in 2025.

businessLines.name: Business and Technology Insights (research subscriptions)
businessLines.how: Clients pay subscriptions for research, benchmarks and advisor access, with revenue recognised ratably on subscription deliverables; Gartner tracks contract value and wallet retention as the key metrics.

businessLines.name: Conferences
businessLines.how: Revenue from the destination conferences Gartner hosts (53 in 2025, 51 in 2024); the split between attendee and sponsor payments was not read.

businessLines.name: Consulting
businessLines.how: Project fees from clients for consulting and benchmark-analytics engagements; non-recurring, with $173.7M of backlog at 2025-12-31.

businessLines.name: Other (Digital Markets, sold 2026-02-05)
businessLines.how: Digital Markets (software-review and lead-generation business) was below the reporting threshold and sits in Other; sold for about $110M in February 2026.

brands.name: Gartner Digital Markets
brands.note: Sold 2026-02-05 for about $110M; was in Other with $227.4M of 2025 revenue.
